text: Is it normal for pre-approval to take almost 3 weeks?? We submitted everything on time and it's been radio silence from our lender. Starting to worry we'll lose the house we want to bid on. Anyone else deal with this?
comment_source_reason: A frustrated buyer asking whether a slow pre-approval is normal draws responses from loan officers competing for the business, other CA buyers comparing their own timelines (buyer leads), and agents chiming in with lender recommendations (partner-segment leads) — a dense mix of MLO leads and competitors.
